clue.text: Loud shrieking disturbed a bird

indicators.note: letters that are disturbed are thrown out of order, so the pool is rearranged

parts.note: F, forte, is the musical abbreviation for loud

explanation.surface: Someone notices a bird made a racket after being disturbed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disturbed' rearranges F plus SHRIEKING; the surface makes it sound like the bird was the one disturbed.
explanation.definitionFit: The kingfisher is a brightly coloured river bird that dives for fish.

clue.text: Bird that may be all black?

definitions.text: Bird that may be all black?

parts.words: Bird that may be all black?
parts.note: the national rugby team of New Zealand is the All Blacks, and a New Zealander is nicknamed after the country's flightless bird

explanation.surface: Wonders about a bird with entirely dark plumage.
explanation.walkthrough: The All Blacks are the New Zealand rugby union team.
explanation.definitionFit: The flightless national bird of New Zealand gives its name to New Zealanders, including All Blacks rugby players.

clue.text: An elevating Kipling poem of unaffected simplicity

indicators.note: in a down clue, elevating lifts the word upward so it reads backwards

parts.note: If is a famous poem by Rudyard Kipling

explanation.surface: An uplifting Kipling poem that is plainly sincere.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'elevating' means reading upward, so the surface's uplifting poem is really a reversal signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Naive and artless people show innocent, unsophisticated simplicity.

clue.text: Pop star, for example, has authority

parts.note: pop is an informal word for father
a star is one example of a shape or figure

explanation.surface: A pop star wields power.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pop star' looks like a celebrity musician, but splits into Pop (dad) and star (a shape).
explanation.definitionFit: A trusted older person looked up to for guidance is a respected, commanding influence.

clue.text: Health resort in the country

parts.note: a spa is a resort with mineral springs taken for health

explanation.surface: A health resort located in the countryside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the country' suggests rural land, but the definition is a nation.
explanation.definitionFit: Spain is a nation of the Iberian peninsula in south-western Europe.

clue.text: Points to oppose in the meeting

parts.note: E and N, east and north, are points of the compass
to counter something is to oppose it

explanation.surface: A list of arguments against a motion at a meeting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Points' suggests debating arguments but means compass points.
explanation.definitionFit: A coming together, often by chance, is a meeting between people.

clue.text: A spinner at his peak?

parts.note: a top is a toy that spins

explanation.surface: Asks whether a spin bowler is at the height of his career.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spinner' suggests a cricket spin bowler, but it is the child's spinning toy.
explanation.definitionFit: Something sitting on the very summit of a thing is perched upon its highest point.

clue.text: Offer sprawling lion some meat

parts.note: to tender is to offer, as in tendering a bid

indicators.note: sprawling letters are spread out and jumbled, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone offers a lounging lion a piece of meat.
explanation.definitionFit: Tenderloin is the most tender cut of beef or pork, from the loin.

clue.text: They impressed old sailors

parts.note: sounds like people who made a good impression on seamen, but impressed means forcibly conscripted into naval service

explanation.surface: Some people won the admiration of veteran seamen.
explanation.definitionFit: Groups of men once seized civilians and forced them to serve in the navy.

clue.text: An armed timing device

parts.note: sounds like a weapon such as a bomb's timer, but 'armed' means worn on the arm, at the joint above the hand

explanation.surface: A bomb-style timer that has been armed.
explanation.definitionFit: A small clock strapped round the arm by a band is worn on the body to tell time.

clue.text: Supporter of proposal

parts.note: reads like someone backing a motion, but it is the leg joint a suitor goes down on when asking for marriage

explanation.surface: Someone who backs a motion at a meeting.
explanation.definitionFit: A man traditionally goes down on one leg joint when offering marriage, so it bears his weight.

clue.text: Fighting men who showed courage when put on a charge

definitions.text: Fighting men who showed courage when put on a charge

parts.words: Fighting men who showed courage when put on a charge
parts.note: a charge here is a cavalry attack, the famous doomed one at Balaclava in the Crimean War, not a disciplinary charge

explanation.surface: Soldiers who stayed brave when charged with an offence.
explanation.walkthrough: Tennyson's poem 'The Charge of the Light Brigade' commemorates the British cavalry's suicidal attack in 1854.
explanation.definitionFit: The British light cavalry unit famously rode bravely into Russian guns at Balaclava in 1854.

clue.text: Be earnest about usury

definitions.meaning: to be serious about what one intends
lending at extortionate interest, a stingy or cruel trade

explanation.surface: Someone is serious on the subject of moneylending.
explanation.walkthrough: The second sense reads the phrase literally: usury is a mean (ungenerous) business.
explanation.definitionFit: To be serious and determined in intent is idiomatic; lending at exorbitant interest is literally a miserly trade.

clue.text: A lingering sensation following a smack!

parts.note: after means following in time
a smack is a taste or flavour, as in a smack of garlic

explanation.surface: A stinging feeling that remains after being slapped.
explanation.walkthrough: 'smack' suggests a slap, but here it means a flavour.
explanation.definitionFit: A flavour that stays in the mouth after eating or drinking is a sensation that persists.

clue.text: For clever people, cunning cartoons miss nothing

parts.note: brain here means cleverness or wit, as cunning once meant skill and knowledge
cartoons missing O (nothing) leaves cartons, and cartons are boxes

explanation.surface: Clever folk find crafty cartoons leave nothing out.
explanation.walkthrough: The second piece is indirect: drop O, a zero, from CARTOONS to get CARTONS, then swap it for its synonym.
explanation.definitionFit: A brainbox is an informal British term for a very intelligent person.

clue.text: Van driver's warning expression

parts.note: a golfer driving off shouts fore to warn people ahead
a front is an outward show or face put on, as in a brave front

explanation.surface: A delivery-van driver shouts a warning.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Van' suggests a vehicle, but it is short for vanguard; the 'driver' is a golfer, not a motorist.
explanation.definitionFit: Van, short for vanguard, means the leading position, the very front line.

clue.text: Twist or bust, I've to be forward-looking

indicators.note: to twist the letters is to turn them into a different order

parts.note: the letters of the contraction, apostrophe ignored, taken as they stand

explanation.surface: A gambler weighs whether to twist or bust in a game of pontoon.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Twist or bust' evokes the card game pontoon (blackjack), but 'Twist' rearranges only OR BUST, giving OBTRUS.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone pushy and too forward in manner is conspicuously intrusive.

clue.text: Game in which Harry leads mother

indicators.note: one piece leading another goes in front of it in the answer

parts.note: Hal is a pet form of Harry or Henry, as with Shakespeare's Prince Hal
ma is an informal word for mother

explanation.surface: A family game where Harry goes first ahead of his mum.
explanation.definitionFit: Halma is a board game in which pieces jump across a chequered board to the opposite corner.

clue.text: Examining some money in great detail

indicators.note: only some of the letters of these words are taken, a run hidden across them

explanation.surface: Someone scrutinising a sum of money very closely.
explanation.definitionFit: Looking at something closely is inspecting it with the eyes.

clue.text: Feverish activity in temples?

parts.note: suggests frantic goings-on in places of worship, but the temples are the sides of the head, pulsing with a fevered headache

explanation.surface: Frenzied business in places of worship.
explanation.definitionFit: A pounding headache beats rhythmically at the sides of the head when one is feverish.

clue.text: Trouble's building up, admits copper, and is leading to disorder

indicators.note: one piece admits another by letting it inside
building something up reassembles its parts, so the letters are put together in a new order

parts.note: the word together with its S, used as letters
Cu is the chemical symbol for copper

explanation.surface: Trouble mounts, takes in a policeman, and leads to chaos.
explanation.walkthrough: 'building up' rearranges the letters of Trouble's into TUBERLOS, which 'admits' opens around the copper. 'copper' looks like a policeman but is the metal.
explanation.definitionFit: Tuberculosis is a bacterial disease, chiefly of the lungs, so it is a medical illness.

clue.text: One of those pieces of eight

definitions.text: One of those pieces of eight

parts.words: One of those pieces of eight
parts.note: pieces of eight sound like pirates' Spanish coins, but these are musical pieces written for eight players

explanation.surface: A pirate refers to one of his Spanish coins.
explanation.definitionFit: A composition for eight instruments or voices is a piece scored for a group of eight.

clue.text: A case of pins and needles

definitions.text: A case of pins and needles

parts.words: A case of pins and needles
parts.note: sounds like an attack of tingling numbness, but it is a literal small box holding sewing pins and needles

explanation.surface: Someone suffers an attack of tingling numbness.
explanation.definitionFit: An etui is a small ornamental case for holding needles and other sewing items.

clue.text: Does wrong, gets lines

indicators.note: letters put wrong are set in the wrong order, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone who misbehaves is given lines as punishment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lines' suggests a school punishment but means lines of verse.
explanation.definitionFit: Lyric poems are written in verse, so they are made of poetic lines.

clue.text: Erotic reply to proposal returned, a case for a kiss

indicators.note: the reversed word forms a case around the other piece
returned means the word is sent back, read from the end

parts.note: yes is the hoped-for reply to a marriage proposal
X is the conventional sign for a kiss at the end of a letter

explanation.surface: An accepted marriage proposal sealed with a kiss turns steamy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returned' turns YES into SEY, and 'a case for' wraps it round X.
explanation.definitionFit: Something sexually arousing or alluring is erotic in character.

clue.text: Sent crazy by other claims on your attention?

definitions.meaning: driven mad, in the old sense of the word

definitions.text: by other claims on your attention?
definitions.meaning: describes having one's mind pulled away by competing demands

explanation.surface: Someone driven mad by too many demands on their time.
explanation.definitionFit: The word once meant maddened or deranged, and now means having one's concentration diverted elsewhere.

clue.text: The way to travel to gain time

definitions.text: The way to travel to gain time

parts.words: The way to travel to gain time
parts.note: flying toward the sunrise puts clocks forward, so one gains hours on the local time

explanation.surface: Advice on how to journey so as to save time.
explanation.definitionFit: Heading toward the rising sun moves you into time zones that are hours ahead.

clue.text: Maybe it's the case study of good taste

indicators.note: maybe suggests the letters could be arranged otherwise, signalling a rearrangement

parts.note: the letters of the word, apostrophe ignored

explanation.surface: Perhaps it really is the case that someone is studying good taste.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Maybe' rearranges ITS THE CASE; the surface reads as a hedging remark.
explanation.definitionFit: The branch of philosophy concerned with beauty and artistic judgment is the theory of taste.
